source: Automated native fixture: SettingsRecoverySmokeTest writes the fixture settings files and Run values; no manual interaction.
checks: Settings recovery: truncated JSON backed up before defaults are saved, one notice; null/invalid hotkeys and undefined enums fall back, HotKeyService registers the result; each clamp, colour and blank-folder repair alone keeps a backup and names the field; in-range values cause neither
Launch at login: another copy's Run entry shows off; enabling rewrites it to this executable and shows on
